sources.title: Kendall Square Final Report 2013
sources.publisher: City of Cambridge Community Development Department
sources.use: Primary municipal planning record for testing the relationship among innovation employment, transit, public realm, ground-floor activity and community benefit.
sources.limitations: A Cambridge planning record; it does not establish a transferable planning control or prove current operation of every Kendall Square frontage.

sources.title: Kendall Square
sources.publisher: City of Cambridge Community Development Department
sources.use: Current municipal overview for checking the coexistence of biotechnology and technology firms with housing, shops, restaurants, transit and surrounding neighbourhoods.
sources.limitations: Overview only; it does not prove that individual research or venture-service ground floors are publicly accessible.

sources.title: Quayside Blocks 1 and 2: Zoning By-law Amendment and Part Lot Control Exemption Application – Decision Report
sources.use: Primary municipal decision record for tracing current development governance, ownership arrangements, public realm, mixed uses and affordable housing after the former innovation partnership.
sources.limitations: Project-specific approval record; it does not validate the earlier Sidewalk Labs proposal or transfer Toronto planning permissions to Beijing.

sources.title: Statement from Waterfront Toronto Board Chair, Stephen Diamond
sources.use: Primary project-owner statement confirming Sidewalk Labs' withdrawal and the continuation of public and expert input into Quayside's next phase.
sources.limitations: A short institutional statement, not a complete audit of data governance, procurement or the reasons for every project decision.

sources.title: The final report on the Smart Kalasatama project
sources.use: Primary programme-owner account of long-term neighbourhood experimentation, resident collaboration, agile pilots and transfer of lessons beyond Kalasatama.
sources.limitations: Programme summary; individual pilot outcomes and continued services require their own records before any performance claim is made.

sources.title: Agile pilots
sources.use: Current first-party description of the agile-pilot programme structure, short trial period, co-creation and assessment process developed through Smart Kalasatama.
sources.limitations: Method description only; it does not prove that every pilot was maintained, scaled or successful after assessment.

sources.title: Punggol Digital District
sources.use: Primary district-developer overview for checking integrated planning of a business park, university, public amenities, digital platform, energy and car-lite connectivity.
sources.limitations: Official programme description; operational performance, public access and logistics conditions require separate measured evidence.

sources.title: SIT Officially Opens Punggol Campus, Driving Applied Learning, Innovation and Skills-Based Hiring for Singapore's Future
sources.use: Primary institutional record for checking the campus-industry-community living-lab relationship and precinct-scale test-bed model.
sources.limitations: Institutional announcement; it does not independently verify public-space performance, service continuity or every claimed innovation outcome.

sources.title: Barcelona Municipal Institute of Urban Planning: 2024 Activity Report
sources.publisher: Ajuntament de Barcelona, Institut Municipal d'Urbanisme
sources.use: Primary municipal implementation record for checking the 22@ area's active public-space, infrastructure, heritage and street projects during 2024.
sources.limitations: Annual activity record; it does not by itself explain the full social, housing or economic effects of the district's earlier transformation.

sources.title: More housing, facilities and economic activity in the 22@
sources.use: Primary municipal account of the provisional MPGM update toward mixed uses, affordable housing, facilities, green axes, heritage and everyday urban life.
sources.limitations: Policy announcement; final legal text, delivery status and measured displacement or affordability effects require separate verification.

sources.use: Primary municipal historical record for checking DMC's cluster occupancy, employment, transport access and business-support framing.
